high_level_description: The image depicts two men standing outdoors in front of a building with flags in the background. The man on the left is wearing a dark suit with a pink tie and appears to be gesturing with his right hand, which is clenched into a fist. He has short, light-colored hair and is looking slightly to his right. The man on the right is dressed in a dark coat and has a beard; he is smiling and looking directly at the camera. Behind them, there are two flags: one American flag on the left and another flag that appears to be the Ukrainian flag on the right.
